definitions.explanation: An award given to the best-performing player in a game, season, or tournament.

examples.japanese: MVP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧MVP⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: She was selected as the season MVP.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}{戦|せん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧MVP⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: The player who won MVP in the final answered interview questions.

notes:
MVP stands for Most Valuable Player. It's a common sports award.
